questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns you that the road curves right and then left ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign alerts you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep slope. Low vehicles may have their undercarriage scrape or get caught on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign tells you that the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows the only direction traffic can flow on this street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is ahead and you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This advisory speed sign shows the maximum safe speed to drive when exiting a highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When driving on a multi-lane road, move to another lane if it is safe to do so to make room for vehicles entering the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot park in this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a bridge ahead is narrow. You may not have enough space to pass a truck, so drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the entrance to one-way streets and ramps to tell you not to go in that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a curve is coming up in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road or driveway is not safe to enter from your direction. Turn around and find another route.

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that there is low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay on the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider extends their left arm straight out, it is a hand signal meaning they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show the direction of a sharp curve. This sign indicates a sharp left curve. Multiple chevron signs may appear throughout the curve.
